notes.title: Update 1.05: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
+New game mode: New games will automatically start in "Normal" mode. In this mode the building mechanic is simplified. Buildings can now be constructed by having items in inventory -> click on building -> press build. Players can switch to "Realism" mode via the options screen which restores the more complex building mechanic. 
+Improved tutorial system: More nav markers with clearer information on what to build first.
+Fixed bug where players may not be rewarded monetarily for constructing businesses. 
+Increased night time build reward to 6 hours instead of 4.
+New games now start with access to 5 Nitro's which give speed boost to forklift.
+Amended Kens purchasing logic so he will no longer buy Nitro's.

notes.title: Update 1.04 Steam Deck Update
notes.content: +Player customization menu now works via D-pad and interact button.

notes.title: Update 1.039
notes.content:
+Fixed chainsaw SFX. Now the correct SFX plays when the Chainsaw is used
+Improved Chainsaw text description for required skills.
+Streamlined eating mechanic. It is now possible to eat using the interact key which should help Steam Deck players.

notes.title: Update 1.038 UI Improvements
notes.content:
+Fixed escape key/button behavior on main UI elements
+Button SFX added to House UI

notes.title: Update 1.037
notes.content:
[list]
[*] House and Machine UI now streamlined for Steam Deck (using DPad and Interact button)
[*] Fixed bug where house preview screen would zoom incorrectly if only one house was available to build.
[*] Player name now auto imported from Steam during character customization. However it can be changed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.036 Steam Deck Update
notes.content:
+It is now possible to navigate the player/hardware storage and UltaBox UI using the Dpad. 
+Items can be selected with the interact button.

notes.title: Patch 1.035
notes.content:
+Scanner points can now be activated by walking into them as well as clicking.
+Player will face harvestable object closest to them (when interacting) and is no longer dependent on mouse cursor position.

notes.title: Patch 1.034
notes.content: Updated Gamepad Bindings for interact, tool cycle and drone activation.

notes.title: Patch 1.033
notes.content:
+Windowed mode now works
+Opening drone now closes helper inventory
+Reduced menu overlapping in crafting mode

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
+ZCleaner Overheat message now displays if ZCleaner overheats
+Drone tooltip no longer wonders off-screen
+Storage Helper deactivation when Helperbot on-screen and when drone activated

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
+Scanner direction change no longer random and depends on precipitation
-Player can no longer pass out while napping
+Tool cycle QoL key set to [ (square bracket left)
+Scanner type cursor now sets correctly
+Some minor UI improvements
+Key mapping for Interact (e), toolcycle ([}, Drone (b) now mapped to gamepad buttons by default

Kudos to Nate McCloud for bringing some of these issues to our attention.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
+Changed Application Icon and Name
+Added Click SFX to Customization Screen Buttons
+Increased Player starting speed to 5.5 (will not apply to existing saves)
+Minor text tweaks

notes.title: New Year Update
notes.content:
We've been busy making our new tutorial system and streamlining the first hour or so of gameplay. As we get closer to launch we are focusing in on those first initial moments in Ekoh Beach and creating some tasks that feel right.

Our new Demo is nearly ready too. We are registered for Steam Next Fest and we have to have our Demo all shiny and ready for the start of the festival in February. Its and exiting time for us as we prepare for launch and it will be both awesome and terrifying to have our Demo out to the public during Next Fest!

Functionality-wise we are pretty stable right now and have been polishing existing stuff rather than adding new stuff (well...with the exception of the new Tutorial). We did however add a new Player House, which we didn't expect to do but it made a lot as the tutorial started to take shape.

Our playtesting right now is geared toward the later game and completionism which I guess is a good sign at this stage of development!

The Zenland Team.
